newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Foshan Lighting plans rights offer.
newsitem.headline: China Foshan Lighting plans rights offer.

text.p: Foshan Lighting and Electrical Co Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to issue two rights shares at 8.50 yuan each for every 10 shares held.

The rights plan has been approved by the firm's shareholders and is being considered by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Foshan Lighting said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company said it aims to carry out the rights plan by September 1997. It said the holders of its founder shares have agreed to buy only 7.45 million rights shares.
The offer to B shareholders is priced at HK$7.94 per rights share, equivalent to 8.50 yuan, the firm added.
Trading in Foshan's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning pending the announcement. On Tuesday, Foshan's A shares closed at 15.20 yuan each, with B shares at HK$6.78.
It said it had 275.86 million outstanding shares, including 67.34 million founder shares, 36.83 million legal person shares, 250,830 staff shares, 83.10 million A shares and 75 million B shares.
Foshan Lighting said it would use the proceeds from the issue to finance a project to make fluorescent lamps but gave no further details.
Foshan Lighting also said that the biggest holder of its B shares, Arran Investment PTE Ltd, had reduced its equity stake in the firm to 10.64 percent from 12.64 percent.
Arran sold 5.52 million Foshan B shares between July 24 of this year and November 27, leaving it with 29.36 million Foshan's B shares, the company said but gave no more details. str mon
